text: For the leader; according to "The Lily of.…" A miktam of David (for teaching),
when he fought against Aram-Naharaim and Aram-Zobah; and Joab, coming back, killed twelve thousand Edomites in the Valley of Salt. [AA]
I O God, you rejected us, broke our defenses;you were angry but now revive us.
You rocked the earth, split it open; [AB]repair the cracks for it totters.
You made your people go through hardship,made us stagger from the wine you gave us. [AC]
Raise up a banner for those who revere you,a refuge for them out of bow shot.Selah
[1]Help with your right hand and answer usthat your loved ones may escape.
II [2]In the sanctuary God promised:"I will exult, will apportion Shechem;the valley of Succoth [3] I will measure out.
Gilead is mine, mine is Manasseh;Ephraim is the helmet for my head,Judah, my own scepter. [4]
t[5]Moab is my washbowl;upon Edom I cast my sandal. [6] [AD]I will triumph over Philistia."
III Who will bring me to the fortified city? [7]Who will lead me into Edom?
Was it not you who rejected us, God?Do you no longer march with our armies? [AE]
Give us aid against the foe;worthless is human help.
We will triumph with the help of God,who will trample down our foes.
